name: Prism
description: The resonator. The same sealed suit with the chest shell cut to facets — two angled panels meeting on a ridge, one lit and one in shade, the prism it used to be — and a ribbed tymbal drum set into each side of the ribcage: the cicada's instrument, built into the shell, and what Prism sings with. The chirp is a hum thrown outward in a ring, and the ring is drawn leaving the chest in the idle, faint and cold, because it is a sound and not a scent. The visor runs the whole way round the helmet as a band, and two long thin sensor vanes stand off the back like folded wings. The feelers are held the widest apart on the roster, one thrown forward and one back: the survivor that finds things. The longest legs of the eight, because it is also the one that runs. Dusky rose on the ridge and in the visor band. Same dead core, set on the ridge. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: a resonator's stance, light on long legs: a quick breath, the vanes on the back shivering, the feelers sweeping wide; twice a cycle a ring of chirp leaves the tymbal in the chest shell, grows, and fades

walk.description: a long-legged run: the highest bob of the eight, the vanes lifting off the back on every push, the feelers streaming
